# Part A — Evaluation corpus

*Generated by `make render` from `ablation, adversarial, analysis, bench, corpus_stats, partc, sample_manifest`. Commit
`4260f931772d61db634ce4200543f4e26e29b6b9-dirty` · config hash `db3980b4cec96ce55d630ce534cfc6b56fae57ffdead12da57f63ec4aa573f28`.*

**Source:** FLORES-200, `devtest` split, `NFC` normalised.
**Size:** 1012 parallel sentences × 7 languages.
**Alignment:** validated line-for-line; `corpus/prepare.py` raises
`AlignmentError` on any mismatch rather than truncating.

| lang | script | sentences | whitespace_words | graphemes | codepoints | utf8_bytes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| eng | Latin | 1012 | 21901 | 131966 | 131966 | 132096 |
| hin | Devanagari | 1012 | 25643 | 85978 | 131201 | 337460 |
| kan | Kannada | 1012 | 16100 | 90471 | 138127 | 375441 |
| tam | Tamil | 1012 | 16775 | 99724 | 154131 | 421635 |
| tel | Telugu | 1012 | 16938 | 76602 | 132500 | 353696 |
| ben | Bengali | 1012 | 19506 | 81693 | 130391 | 348729 |
| mar | Devanagari | 1012 | 19046 | 80489 | 133252 | 355712 |

## Preprocessing

Lines are read verbatim and normalised to a single Unicode form. Nothing is
lowercased, filtered or reordered. Both `NFC` and `NFD` variants are built and
carried through the ablation sweep.
